metricNote: (g-b)/max(r,g,b), median per frame over each press. MEASURED 2026-09-04 on 1468 events: white keys blue -0.45..-0.25 (439), green +0.25..+0.70 (363), 9 events at -0.10..0.00; black keys blue -0.40..-0.25 (345), green +0.40..+0.60 (312), none between. Thresholds sit in the gaps.
pressDeviationNote: Euclidean RGB distance from the key own rest colour; the Silksong template measured 120-314 pressed vs at most 23 at rest and this renderer family reads the same (re-measured 2026-09-04 by the probe extraction: every event tint sits 100+ from rest).
handMappingNote: Hand mapping comes from the visible engraved staves, never mean pitch. A held-span failure must not be hidden by this mapping.
onsetLatencyNote: MEASURED 2026-09-04 with compare.mjs against a ByteDance transcription of this video own audio: best constant latency 83ms, residual onset error median 5ms, p90 14ms over 1448 matched notes.
